title: Apprentice
description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
   

  

 You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
   

  

 Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a dedicated and motivated individual to join our team as a Apprentice Technician in the IT industry. As an Apprentice Technician, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop skills in troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining computer hardware systems. This is an entry\-level position suitable for individuals with a passion for technology and a desire to kick\-start their career in the field.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with experienced technicians and be exposed to a wide range of computer hardware components and systems. You will provide support and assistance in diagnosing and resolving technical issues, as well as participate in the installation and configuration of computer hardware/Software.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Assist in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving hardware and software issues
* Perform routine maintenance and repairs on computer systems, including replacing faulty components
* Install, configure, and test computer hardware components and peripherals
* Assist in the monitoring and maintenance of network security systems.
* Troubleshoot network issues and perform necessary repairs or replacements.
* Assist in the installation of computer networks, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Provide technical support to end\-users in a timely and efficient manner
* Collaborate with team members to ensure the smooth operation of SITA systems
* Keep accurate records of repairs, maintenance tasks, and inventory
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in computer hardware technology and industry trends.


**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE:**
 No prior experience required. Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Education \& Qualifications**
* Diploma, Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field equivalent.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware components and systems
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of network hardware, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Should be flexible to work evenings or weekends as required.
* This role requires flexibility to work in rotating shifts, including night shifts.
* Ability to stay composed and perform effectively in high\-pressure environments.


 Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.
   

  

* Must be able to adapt quickly to new processes, tools, and technologies.


  

  

* Having valid Indian passport will be an advantage.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
 **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** 
 and
 **Airport Council International** 
 \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like
 **Pluralsight** 
 for technology upskilling,
 **Harvard Business Publishing** 
 for people leadership,
 **Stanford** 
 for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
   

  

 🙌
 **Competitive Benefits:** 
 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
   

  

*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*
**Salary / Compensation Note**
 Hidden (\-999\)

title: Head – ICT Projects & Digital Infrastructure
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Adani Airports Holding Limited** 
 : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state\-of\-the\-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world\-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- Projects IT will be responsible for managing and overseeing the successful installation, testing and commissioning of IT systems and technologies across all construction projects. This includes overseeing IT infrastructure deployments, construction project management systems, and ensuring the integration of advanced technology solutions to support efficient airport construction processes. The role requires collaboration with internal teams, external contractors, and stakeholders to ensure IT systems are aligned with construction objectives, safety regulations, and compliance standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**IT Project Management:**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects focused on construction, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration, project management software (e.g., SAP or Oracle), and real\-time data analytics tools.
* Coordinate the implementation of IT systems for construction project monitoring, scheduling, resource allocation, and cost tracking.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, ensuring alignment with construction timelines, safety standards, and airport regulations.


**Construction IT Systems**
* Ensure that technology solutions, such as BIM, are effectively integrated with airport construction activities to enhance project collaboration and improve efficiency.
* Oversee the deployment of IT systems that support digital twins, GIS mapping, construction automation tools, data centers, network architecture, communication systems and compliance with aviation and construction standards.
* Manage the installation of network infrastructure, including fiber optics, IoT sensors, and wireless systems to support real\-time project tracking and remote monitoring.
* Collaborate with airport operations to provide operational support for critical 24/7 airport functions related to construction projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Collaborate with the construction and IT teams, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory bodies to deliver IT projects that support the airport's construction activities.
* Act as a liaison between the IT department and construction stakeholders to ensure technology meets project requirements and adheres to regulatory compliance.


**Risk Management \& Compliance**
* Identify potential IT risks related to construction projects and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure that all IT systems used in construction meet industry standards and aviation regulations (e.g., ICAO, IATA) and comply with cybersecurity and data protection protocols.
* Address health and safety concerns by ensuring that IT systems are designed to support safe construction practices.


**Budget And Financial Oversight**
* Oversee the IT project budget specific to construction, ensuring cost\-effective use of resources and technology investments.
* Provide financial forecasts and reports on project IT expenditures to senior management.


**Vendor And Contract Management**
* Negotiate and manage relationships with IT vendors, ensuring the delivery of quality services and adherence to contractual obligations.
* Oversee the procurement of IT systems and services, ensuring alignment with the airport's long\-term technology roadmap.


**Digital Mindset**
* Drive the adoption of innovative digital technologies like BIM, IoT, and data analytics to enhance efficiency in construction projects.
* Stay updated with emerging construction technologies to improve efficiency and ensure airport infrastructure is built using advanced IT solutions.


**Team Leadership And Development**
* Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.
* Develop a pipeline of talent within the team to ensure continuity in IT projects.
* Actively engage the team by promoting a positive work culture and recognizing individual and collective achievements.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
* Head \- Construction
* Project Head
* IT Department Head
* Project Management Team
* IT Infrastructure Team
* Construction Engineers
* Techno Commercial \& Contracts Department
* Compliance \& Regulatory Department
* Finance and Budgeting Team


**Key Stakeholders \- External**
* Civil Aviation Authority
* Technology Vendors and Service Providers
* External Contractors and Subcontractors
* Government Regulatory Bodies
* IT Consultants
* Health and Safety Agencies
* External Auditors and Inspectors
* BCAS/DGCA


**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology/Electronics/Instrumentation or a related field.
* A Master’s degree in IT or Project Management, or relevant certifications (PMP, PRINCE2\) is preferred.


**Work Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience in IT project management, with specific experience in managing IT systems for large\-scale infrastructure or construction projects with minimum 5 years experience in airports.

title: Deputy Manager, IT User Support
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The role is responsible for providing expert\-level day\-to\-day technical support to employees across hardware and software systems, with a strong focus on complex troubleshooting, fault rectification, and timely resolution. The role independently diagnoses and resolves advanced issues, ensures effective escalation and coordination when required, and contributes to root\-cause analysis to prevent recurrence. The role maintains high service quality and SLA adherence, ensures accurate documentation, and upholds IT policies and information security practices, while serving as a technical authority without people\-management responsibility.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Resolve complex hardware and software issues independently
* Transition from hands\-on technical support to leading IT user support operations, driving team performance, SLA adherence, and service delivery excellence
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Manage escalations and coordinate with specialist teams
* Ensure timely incident closure in line with SLAs
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions
* Maintain detailed incident and resolution documentation
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure adherence to IT policies and security standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement of support processes


**Job Responsibilities – Plant It Lead**
* Plant IT Leadership \& Service Delivery: Lead end\-to\-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* Quality \& Manufacturing Informatics: Provide techno\-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems, ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* Plant IT Infrastructure: Own and manage plant\-level LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end\-user computing infrastructure to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
* Information Security: Ensure implementation and monitoring of endpoint security, OS\-level access controls, logical access, patch management, vulnerability remediation, local firewall controls, and other applicable information security requirements.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Audits: Act as the Plant IT SPOC for regulatory and customer audits and ensure compliance with GxP, SOX, Data Privacy, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* IT Governance \& SOP Management: Establish, implement, and maintain Plant IT SOPs, procedures, standards, controls, and governance frameworks in coordination with Quality and relevant business functions.
* IT Projects \& Digitization: Lead plant\-level IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, digital transformation, automation, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and technology initiatives in alignment with business requirements.
* Vendor \& Partner Management: Manage IT vendors and service partners, including performance monitoring, SLA/OLA compliance, escalation management, technical evaluation, and contract/service governance.
* Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery: Ensure effective implementation, monitoring, and periodic testing of backup, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions for critical plant IT systems.
* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the Plant IT team, allocate resources effectively, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of IT incidents, service requests, and business requirements.
* Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Plant Leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, HR, Finance, Corporate IT, Cybersecurity, and other functions to understand requirements and deliver effective IT solutions.
* IT Service Performance: Monitor Plant IT performance through SLA/OLA, incident management, problem management, service availability, MTTR, and user satisfaction, ensuring continuous improvement of IT services.
* Technology \& Infrastructure Planning: Work closely with the Head – IT Infrastructure \& Information Security on IT strategy, capacity planning, technology roadmap, budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and infrastructure standardization across the plant.
* CSV / Computerized System Compliance: Provide support for computerized system validation lifecycle activities, including assessment, qualification, change management, periodic review, and retirement of GxP\-relevant computerized systems.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, standardization, cost optimization, and technology modernization to improve plant productivity, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.

* 8 years or more in 8 \- 10 Years

* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end connectivity issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud ecosystems.
* Design resilient architectures eliminating single points of failure.

* Develop architecture diagrams, design documentation, reference architectures, and operational standards.

* Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and strengthen compliance posture.

* Analyze telemetry and logs to improve reliability and performance.

* Strong Terraform, Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation capabilities.

description:
**Exp Required \- 5\+ years**




  





**Job Summary:**




  





 We are seeking a highly skilled
 **CISCO Network Engineer** 
 with a strong background in CISCO networking technologies to join our team. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in network design, implementation, and troubleshooting, as well as a deep understanding of CISCO hardware and software.
 



  





**Required Skills:**




  





 · Design, implement, and maintain complex network infrastructures based on CISCO technologies.
 



 · Configure and troubleshoot CISCO routers, switches, firewalls, and other networking devices.
 



 · Monitor network performance and proactively identify and resolve issues.
 



 · Ensure network security and compliance with industry standards and regulations.
 



 · Provide training and support to other IT staff and end\-users.
 



 · Extensive knowledge of CISCO networking technologies including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, STP, VTP, VLAN, EIGRP, BGP, IPsec, SSL, FlexVPN, DMVPN, Layer\-2 \& Layer\-3\.
 



 · Experience with network protocols such as TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, and MPLS.
 



 · Experience with network monitoring tools and software such as SolarWinds, PRTG, or Nagios.
 



 · Strong understanding of wireless technology (Cisco WLC, Cisco AP, Unifi).

title: SCADA Engineer
description:
**📍 Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
 



**🏢 Company:** 
 EIT Automation Pvt. Ltd.
 



**💼 Experience:** 
 1–4 Years
 



**🎓 Qualification:** 
 B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or related field
 



**About EIT Automation** 




 EIT Automation Pvt. Ltd. is a leading automation company specializing in
 **SCADA, PPC, EMS, HPPC, and BESS** 
 solutions for Renewable Energy projects. With a proven portfolio of
 **20\+ GW** 
 across India, we deliver automation solutions for Solar, Wind, Hybrid, and Battery Energy Storage Systems.
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Develop and configure SCADA applications and HMI graphics.
* Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/IP, Modbus RTU, IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61850, and OPC UA.
* Integrate field devices including Inverters, RTUs, Energy Meters, Weather Stations, and other plant equipment.
* Perform Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and troubleshooting.
* Configure alarms, trends, historian, reports, and user management.
* Prepare technical documentation and commissioning reports.
* Coordinate with customers, EPCs, and internal engineering teams.



**Required Skills** 



* 1–2 years of experience in SCADA/Industrial Automation.
* Knowledge of PLCs, SCADA systems, and industrial communication protocols.
* Experience with ICONICS GENESIS64 or similar SCADA platforms is preferred.
* Basic understanding of networking, Ethernet switches, VPNs, and Windows Server.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem\-solving skills.



**Travel Requirement** 



* **This role requires frequent travel across India for project commissioning, testing, site support, and customer interactions. Candidates should be willing to travel for short\- and long\-duration assignments based on project requirements.**



**Why Join EIT Automation?** 



* Work on utility\-scale Solar, Wind, Hybrid, and BESS projects.
* Exposure to advanced SCADA, PPC, EMS, and Hybrid Plant Controller technologies.
* Opportunity to work with leading Renewable Energy developers and EPCs.
* Excellent learning and career growth opportunities in the Renewable Energy Automation sector.
